emily: Ok team — planning SI onboarding for July cohort. Need final playbook, hands-on lab env, and a 2-week enablement schedule. Can we sync? @suresh @maria
suresh: I can lead the hands-on labs. Need a sandbox: private VPC tenant, GPU nodes, sample dataset. What's retention SLA for demo data?
maria: For cert, propose two tracks: Integrator (hands-on) and Architect (deep ops). Written quiz + live lab. 90min. Badge via Accredify? Need pass criteria and rubric.
alex: Marketplace listing will need partner agreement, logos, tested deploy template (CloudFormation/Terraform). I can start the PR once we have SKU and IaC.
dan: I'll provision a demo tenant and temporary credits. Quick Q — show private deploy (VPC) or dedicated reserved? Recommend start with hosted + dedicated fallback.
partner-bot: New partner intake: EdgeWave SI — rachel@edgewave.com (submitted)
emily: Let's run weekly office hours — Wednesdays 10am PT for 4 weeks. Suresh + Maria to own sessions. Sync next Tue 1pm PT to review lab steps. Agenda draft below:
```
- Week0: orientation + self-serve lab access
- Week1: core playbook + deploy patterns (hosted/dedicated/private)
- Week2: cert exam prep + live lab (quantization + performance)
- Week3: go-to-market + marketplace listing + co-selling kit
```
maria: Add runbook for rollback, privacy & data handling checklist, and exam invalidation rules.
suresh: I'll drop a notebook with sample inference pipeline and quantization notes. Need sample model (gpt-small) and an inference budget to test.
alex: Opening marketplace PR today; aiming to attach deployment template by Friday.
dan: Provisioned demo tenant: https://redwood-demo.internal/tenants/edgewave-1718504321 — creds in 1Password (EdgeWave Onboard). Please confirm access.
emily: Flagging to Legal for partner agreement + marketplace terms. Success metrics: time-to-first-deploy, cert pass rate, first-month co-sell pipeline. Anything else?
partner-bot: Reminder: Office hours invite created (Wednesdays 10am PT) — https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123 :calendar:
